name: A Musician's Solace
source:
An interactive biography in the form of a 2D dialogue-driven game that explores the life of the classical musician Clara Schumman. Following phases of her life, the player is allowed to take in information about who she is and her accomplishments. This game strives to begin to include women classical musicians more often in the narrative.

[From [url=https://dalsdoodle.itch.io/a-musicians-solace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作以对话驱动的2D游戏形式，呈现古典音乐家克拉拉·舒曼的互动传记。玩家将走过她人生的不同阶段，了解她的生平与成就。这款游戏希望让女性古典音乐家更多地进入人们讲述的历史之中。

[摘自[url=https://dalsdoodle.itch.io/a-musicians-solace]Itch.io[/url]]
